g.text: After storage migration every object in etcd is v1beta1, so reads and writes at v1beta1 are plain
encode and decode and never leave the apiserver. Only v1alpha1 traffic crosses to the controller, and
when no controller replica is ready only that traffic fails; nothing stored is touched.
Trust runs one way. The apiserver verifies kaalm-controller-tls against the caBundle that cainjector
keeps in each CRD (annotation cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from: kaalm-system/kaalm-controller-tls).
The controller verifies nothing about the caller: a ConversionReview carries no authority.
